SingleAgentFinding.description: One finding of the single-agent Flash review, in the shape the reviewer writes it.

title.description: At most 80 characters, imperative, without a [P#] tag.
title.title: Title

priority.description: P0: drop everything to fix, blocks release or major usage. P1: urgent, fix in the next cycle. P2: normal, fix eventually. P3: low, nice to have.
priority.title: Priority

file.description: File path relative to the repository root.
file.title: File

line_start.description: First line of the finding in the file at the PR's head commit.
line_start.title: Line Start

line_end.description: Last line of the finding at the head commit. Null for a single line.
line_end.title: Line End

body.description: One paragraph of about 300-400 characters: the trigger (the input, state, or environment the problem needs), the consequence, and the anchor (the function, call site, or invariant involved). End with at most one short clause on the fix direction.
body.title: Body

suggestion_code.description: Only when the fix is a small replacement you are certain of: the exact new code for line_start to line_end, with the original indentation. Null otherwise.
suggestion_code.title: Suggestion Code

SingleAgentFinding.title: SingleAgentFinding

description: The single-agent Flash review's whole answer for one PR.

findings.description: Every qualifying finding. Empty when nothing qualifies.
findings.title: Findings

overall_correctness.description: Whether the patch is free of bugs and other blocking issues.
overall_correctness.title: Overall Correctness

overall_explanation.description: One to three sentences that justify overall_correctness.
overall_explanation.title: Overall Explanation

title: SingleAgentReview
